3,768 reviews on a pearl farm. That number tells you something.

Ngoc Hien Pearl Farm on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is where you see how Phu Quoc pearls actually go from oyster to jewelry. Watch the harvest process, handle the shells, then browse pieces made on-site. Not a mall kiosk. The real source.

4.2 stars across nearly 4,000 opinions. Worth the stop. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
